description: Insiyab for Avalonia: the glass, RTL-first design system as Avalonia themes.
releaseNotes:
0.3.0

Breaking changes
- MenuItem.bad and the pop card's pop-item bad are now danger; bad is gone.
- List rows draw their background, selection mark and focus ring with an internal RowBack: a style on a ListBoxItem's PART_Back as a Border no longer matches. Every list row draws its focus ring inside (FocusAdorner is null).
- Pops place themselves from their real size (Placement Custom): they slide along the window edge instead of flipping sideways, turn up only when needed, go beside a tall trigger, and fit the window's height (MaxCardHeight).
- The text menus of TextBox and SelectableTextBlock are PopMenus.
- A DescriptionItem shows a control as itself; only text takes the selectable template.
- MonthCalendar's head has a new default order (HeaderLayout Centered: Today and the hours switch, then the date between its arrows, then the views); HeaderLayout TitleStart puts the date first. The hours toggle is a small switch.
- Table.Rebuild keeps the row of every item still there (matched by Equals) and the sort stays in force after it; CellText cells do not follow an item's own changes (use CellBinding).
- With Timeline.DayOf set, ItemsSource reads back the projection that holds the day headings.
- Toc.Offset is measured below the new ScrollMargin.
- Arabic search folds more: compatibility forms, all marks and direction marks, Persian yeh, keheh and alef wasla, repeated spaces.

Changed
- The light rim keeps its bright top and fades to the hairline on the sides and bottom; panel heads and feet use the hairline.
- Links (HyperlinkButton and the new Button.link) take the brand-soft tone with an underline under the pointer.
- Bare and link buttons keep their rounded face under the pointer and when on, and never clip their text's ink.
- The close cross grows a little under the pointer and dips when pressed, instead of turning.
- Words built into the library can follow the app's language: InsiyabTheme.SetLanguage(language, strings).

Added
- Fold (height motion for any content), Expander flush and a fold chevron; Accordion filled from data.
- DescriptionList, Timeline (day headings, unread dot, live tones) and Steps (per-step marker, pulse) filled from data.
- Pill sm, outline, mute, a bare dot, dot peek that grows into the pill, Pill.Icon; Avatar xl and xxl centred by ink; DateBadge; categorical colours cat1 to cat8.
- Surfaces tile, sheet and desk; panel tones, band head, low and dense.
- ListBox master, ruled and compact; ListRow headings and states; sticky headings; a flying selection mark; side tabs (ListBox.nav).
- Table rows added, removed, replaced and moved one at a time; TableColumn.Width with star widths and CellBinding.
- ComboBox.searchable with keywords and groups; public ArabicMatch.Normalize and Matches; public TextDirection.
- TrailingRow; ChoiceGrid Fill, MaxColumns and masonry; Toolbar.AtEnd and chip rows with a +N menu; TextBox.grow; ProgressBar.grow; ProgressRing.sm; ToggleSwitch.sm; FileUpload ShowList False; stat-hint clamp.
- CommandPalette Description, IsSearchOnly and Text; Notify HeadActions and a stacked head; Toc ScrollMargin and IsSticky.
- RichText with selection across paragraphs, spans and links; prose for SelectableTextBlock and bound text; ProseList.Marker; the Flash entrance.
- Media parts: MediaBar, MediaSeekRow (fixed time slots, live state, back to live), MediaSurface, MediaTile and MediaControlBar with default buttons that apps extend; PictureViewer that grows out of its thumbnail (Dialog.GrowsFromAnchor).
- NotifyAreaIcon: a notification-area icon with balloons and a native menu on Windows.
- MonthCalendar event cards placed beside their event and growing out of it (EventDetails, ShowDetails); day, week and month switches and steps animate; Split.joined; PopCard MatchTargetWidth, OpensBeside and GrowsFromTarget; Icon.IsFilled and Icon dir.

Fixed
- Submenus no longer open detached in right to left, and a quick reopen no longer crashes.
- The ComboBox list keeps room for its shadow; pops no longer show the trigger's hand cursor.
- A lifted button or card keeps its hit area under a resting pointer; only a button's leading icon nudges.
- Choice.Description shows under a CheckBox or RadioButton label.
- Calendar events past midnight continue on the next day in the week and day views; the week columns keep their width.
- A compact Timeline's text clears its icon; the status bar's sizes stay with its own items; the bell closes from its foot.
- A small ProgressRing hides a label that does not fit; the top bar's side zones never overlap the caption buttons.
- The date calendar's footer puts its switch on its own line when the row does not fit.
- A Timeline inside a page scroller shows every event; list row tracking no longer costs the square of the rows.
- A dismiss button inside a pop card closes the card, not the window.
title: Insiyab for Avalonia
